sentences.en: When Columbus discovered America, bison (American buffalo) inhabited a wide-ranging area.
sentences.zh: 1. 当哥伦布发现美洲时，野牛（美国野牛）广泛地栖息在这个地区。

sentences.en: Most of the islands in this area are inhabited.
sentences.zh: 2. 这个区域中的大多数岛屿都有人居住。

sentences.en: It is rumored that this house is inhabited by a demon.
sentences.zh: 3. 据说这所房子里住着一个恶魔。
